images.caption: A cream hopper holds a composed piece: a blue cartoon character with a rounded face and eyes flanked by a yellow-orange bubble-letter piece and a small 'Coffee' logo. The character work makes it a standout pictorial-letters piece.
A BNSF boxcar, 485894, is covered in a yellow and green wildstyle piece with a clean white panda face worked into the lettering. The character face lifts it above a standard throw-up.
A COER boxcar, 723456, wears a yellow and blue piece reading 'FIRE EAGLE' with two small white face characters flanking the text. Bright, composed, and easy to read.

A large, multi-colored piece with purple and blue wildstyle lettering and a spiked, flame-like lower fill runs along the bottom of a grey boxcar. The car sits on a track by a body of water with a forested hillside behind it.

A boxcar with a 'CN' logo and a large, multi-colored piece of graffiti featuring stylized characters and imagery along the bottom. The piece is a more complex work of art on a tan car, with green and white colors.

A Kansas City Southern boxcar with a 'Building America' logo and a piece of graffiti that includes stylized characters or imagery along the bottom. The piece is a mix of letters and shapes on a tan car.
A multi-color piece with peach and teal letters and a character element covers the side of a TILX hopper. The car is a TILX 541100, passing along a lakeside cut.
A multi-color piece with peach and teal letters and a character element covers the side of a TILX hopper. The car is a TILX 540908, passing along a lakeside cut.
A bold, dark throw-up with pink and purple accents covers the side of an AGPX hopper, the piece's letters reading roughly 'SAGA'. It sits on a tree-lined track beside a calm lake.

A long, low mural of pale blue and white stylized wave or ribbon shapes with small colored accents fills the lower panel of a Ferromex auto-carrier, a composed pictorial piece rather than standard lettering. The car sits beside a lake with a forested shoreline and a snow-capped peak behind.

The same pale blue and white wave-style pictorial mural seen on the previous car continues along the lower panel of this Ferromex auto-carrier, a clean composed piece. A CSX auto-carrier is clipped at the right edge.

A multi-color piece with a stylized character and outline work is painted on the lower side of a Union Pacific boxcar. The piece is a standard graffiti style, with the car's factory paint visible above it.

A multi-colored, outlined blockbusters piece in teal, pink, and yellow sits low on the panel next to a white circular character logo, covering most of the car's side. It is a BNSF hopper lettered 475343.

A large, composed white character piece with intricate linework and shading is worked onto the side of this BNSF boxcar, a deliberate mural-style figure standing out on the maroon paint. It is paired with a clean BNSF 477354 on the right.
A multi-colored graffiti piece with green and white lettering and a circular logo is painted on a brown BNSF hopper car, number 479954. The art is spread across the lower half of the car.

A white auto-carrier is a busy multi-piece canvas, with a prominent blue 'GATX' lettered panel, a colorful red and green piece on the right, and a small character or figure worked into the louvered sections. The layered, multi-color paint makes it the standout car of the pass.

A full-length painted mural in muted earth tones covers the side of NOKL boxcar 447541, its imagery running across the whole panel. The piece is set against a wide lake and a distant mountain under a soft, cloudy sky.

A muted architectural mural in grey and olive tones covers the side of WFRX boxcar 447325, its geometric imagery spanning the panel. The car is framed by a white boxcar on the left and a BNSF on the right.

A composed piece with a teal-capped cartoon character face worked between bubble letters in white, blue, and green on a maroon BNSF hopper (490548). It is the cleanest, most intentional piece of the pass, set against the lake and pines.

A multi-color piece of blue, white, and red lettering with character work is visible on the lower half of a yellow TTX boxcar, the piece text reading 'TTX' in the center. The car is lettered 'Railcar Pooling Experts' above the art.

A BNSF hopper lettered 441730 carries a multi-color piece with stylized letters and a row of pointed pink-and-green shapes along its lower panel, the most colorful paint in this pass. The car reads BNSF with the road name in white.

A composed multi-color piece with a row of stylized characters and green accents fills the lower panel of a GATX boxcar lettered 75335. The lettering is worked into a deliberate, picture-like composition that stands out from the routine tags on the rest of the train.

The same winged character piece from the previous frame is now seen on the left as the BNSF 482998 boxcar moves further into view, revealing a white 'JASON' throw-up on its right side. The train continues past the lake.

A striking piece of white and black wildstyle lettering with a large, detailed winged character dominates the side of a BNSF boxcar. The artwork is crisp against the maroon paint, set against a lake and mountain view.
A large, composed red and blue pictorial piece covers the side of a grey TTX boxcar, reading as a bold abstract mural rather than lettering. The car is a TTX boxcar lettered 708370.

A BNSF 474768 hopper is wrapped in a large white-and-black pictorial piece, big stylized character shapes filling the whole side panel with a circular logo at the end. A composed, image-first work that stands out strongly.

A large white stencil-style piece with a heart and character imagery covers the full side of a grey auto-rack, with a dark tag on the right end. The car is centered, with a brown boxcar and a yellow auto-rack flanking it.
A full-length pictorial piece in blue and yellow covers the side of a hopper, featuring a complex pattern of abstract shapes and characters. The car is lettered BNSF 477305.

A silver GATX boxcar, 75488, wears a long, low-profile character piece: a stylized brown and cream slug or worm body stretched across the lower panel, with the word SLOW worked into it. The character is composed and intentional, making it the standout of the pass.

A BNSF hopper lettered 474173 shows a full blue-and-white block-letter piece reading "EIDU" on a white panel, with a cartoon character in a blue cap worked into the left edge. The BNSF logo reads clean on the factory-red side.
